title: Euler–Mascheroni Constant (γ)
subtitle: Constant · Analysis
summary: Limit of the difference between the harmonic series and ln n. Unknown if irrational.
detail:
\[ \gamma = \lim_{n\to\infty}\left(\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{k} - \ln n\right) = 0.57721566490153\ldots \]

Whether \(\gamma\) is rational or irrational is unknown — one of the most famous open questions in mathematics. Appears in the digamma function \(\psi(1)=-\gamma\), the Riemann zeta function, integrals like \(\int_0^\infty e^{-t}\ln t\,dt=-\gamma\), and the asymptotic expansion of the harmonic numbers.
